com.esignal.jstandard.beans.marketdepth

Interface NetOrderImbalanceRecord

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    DefaultNetOrderImbalanceRecord

    public interface NetOrderImbalanceRecord
    Purpose of this class is to hold Net Order Imbalance Record information. Net Order Imbalance is updated 15 minutes prior to open and 15 minutes before the close. Each Net Order Imbalance record contains the enum for imabalaceSide, symbol, CurrRefPrice, FarIndRefPrice, NearIndRefPrice, ShortSaleRestrictFillPrice, NumSharesPaired, NumSharesImb, enum for NoIndClearPrice, enum for PriceVarIndicator, time and ReservedPrice values.
    Since:
    01-08-000
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation
